title: Phase C R1 — provenance-bound operator_goal: only the trusted operator goal may mint Goal Contract, network, delivery, and language authority
description: ROOT CAUSE on BASE 3737fc4: boundMissionGoal composes a delegated mission goal as '[BUSINESS …]' provenance + operator goal + an appended '[AGENT CONTEXT — last N outcomes]' section of history bullets; every authority-derivation site (extractGoalContract, extractGoalHosts, goalRequiresCurrentExternalData, detectTelegramDeliveryIntent, detectOutputLanguage, planner sanitization, runtime revalidation) consumed that whole enriched string, so history bullets minted fabricated OBL_*/DEL_*, authorized context URLs, and minted delivery/language intent → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_INCOMPLETE → PLANNER_RUN_EXHAUSTED → Objective INTEGRITY_FAULT. AUDIT R1 REJECTED the intermediate format-based fix (header/bullet inference silently stripped genuine operator Markdown). FIX (provenance, not parsing): a new canonical mission authority field operator_goal is pinned at the provenance seams — startBoundMission derives it from the loaded work_item row (never caller input), preview/confirm digest-bind it into mission_input + effective_input_digest, openWorkItem/persist flows thread it through, service.createMissionInternal reserves it (metadata shadowing → FAIL_CLOSED_METADATA_AUTHORITY_SHADOWING), and a bound-mission provenance helper recovers it for legacy bound rows via bound_open_id → work_item.goal. Every authority-derivation site now resolves operatorGoalOf(mission): Goal Contract extraction, planner contract block + sanitize/repair, extractGoalHosts/network-demand/subject matching, Telegram intent detection at preview/confirm AND the runtime revalidation sites, output-language authority. The enriched envelope still reaches the LLM prompt verbatim as MISSION GOAL context; mission.goal text, goal_digest, plan digests, pinned plans, retry/idempotency, assertPlanCoverage/assertPlanDataflow, source authorization, and executor governance are unchanged — coverage machinery now sees the correct authority scope only. Regressions pin: bare vs enriched goals mint identical requirements; operator Markdown sections/bullets keep full authority; context URLs never authorize hosts; context Telegram/language phrases never mint intent; genuine operator network+Telegram requests still work; delegated work item → unified planner → mission runtime completes under operator authority; preview/confirm/replay/legacy-bound-mission paths bind or recover provenance; goal-digest drift and metadata shadowing fail closed.
